methodology: Same Windows Chrome tab, production Vite build with React profiling renderer, synthetic data, 7.5 seconds per Today size, first 800 ms excluded; seven steady commits per size. Before and after each run once. No CPU throttling. Fetch latency simulation is not actual WAN. cachedFormatters=false means the previous audit override is disabled; both runs use the actual product implementation. React durations exclude layout/paint. Source snapshots preserve the uncommitted baseline.
